summary: Glass House Brands filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian continuous-disclosure notice under NI 51-102) disclosing an auditor change: BDO USA, P.C. resigned at the Company's request effective November 6, 2026, and Macias Gini & O'Connell LLP was appointed successor, with audit committee and board approval. BDO, engaged September 11, 2026, issued no auditor's report and resigned mid-review of Q3 2026 financials, including accounting for the June 2026 deconsolidation of Glass House Retail, LLC; it reached no conclusion. No deal terms, no price, no advisor mandate. Watch for restatement or filing-delay risk tied to the deconsolidation accounting.
